mapper.insert: insert into learning_agent_message (session_id, user_id, role, content, content_type, refs_json, task_id, result_json, tokens, status, create_time) values (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{content}, #{contentType}, #{refsJson}, #{taskId}, #{resultJson}, #{tokens}, '0', sysdate())
mapper.select: select message_id, session_id, user_id, role, content, content_type, refs_json, task_id, result_json, tokens, status, create_time from learning_agent_message where session_id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '0' order by message_id asc
mapper.update: update learning_agent_message set status = '1' where session_id = #{sessionId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = '0'
